_readme: Findings shown one by one on the animated hero brain (docs/js/hero-brain.js). regions = Brainnetome-246 region ids (1-246) to light up; anchor = the region the callout line points to (defaults to the first id); datasets = DATASET names from docs/assets/data_updated.tsv (clicking the chip opens that dataset). Only state what the cited paper reports. Run scripts/build_hero_brain.py to check the region ids.

findings.finding: Default-mode hub whose network topology flags mild cognitive impairment, the precursor stage of Alzheimer's.
findings.citation: Bhattacharya, Kaur, Aithal et al. · Frontiers in Neuroscience · 2025

findings.finding: Amygdala volume shows a small positive association with political conservatism in a preregistered replication (n = 928).
Tau-PET in the entorhinal cortex best separated Alzheimer's neuropathologic change from primary age-related tauopathy.

findings.region: Left inferior frontal & middle temporal gyri
findings.finding: Arithmetic skill is linked to gray-matter volume in the left inferior frontal and middle temporal gyri (n = 536).
Thalamocortical connectivity shifts from sensorimotor to salience networks between infancy and childhood.
